events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Dylan Cease carried a no-hitter into the seventh inning and Nathan Lukes' homer in the eighth inning was the difference as the Toronto Blue Jays beat the New York Yankees 4-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Cease carries no-hitter into 7th inning as Blue Jays hang on for 4-3 win over Yankees

headlines.description: — Jake Bauers capped a marathon plate appearance with a tiebreaking two-run homer, Logan Henderson pitched six strong innings and the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Atlanta Braves 4-1 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Bauers homers and Logan Henderson delivers in Brewers' 4-1 victory over Braves

headlines.description: — Heriberto Hernández and Jakob Marsee hit solo homers, Eury Pérez pitched five innings and the Miami Marlins beat the Washington Nationals 4-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hernández, Marsee homer in the Marlins' 4-2 win over the Nationals

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Rookie Andrew Painter pitched seven strong innings and Kyle Schwarber hit his MLB-leading 38th homer of the season as the Philadelphia Phillies extended their winning streak to eight games with a 12-3 rout of the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Painter works 7 strong innings, Schwarber hits MLB-leading 38th HR as Phillies rout Cardinals 12-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Dylan Beavers led off the 10th inning with a pinch double to right-center to score automatic runner Leody Taveras from second and give the Baltimore Orioles a 3-2 victory over the AL East-leading Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beavers leads off 10th with pinch double to lift the Orioles past the Rays, 3-2

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Rookie Ryan Johnson carried a no-hitter into the sixth inning for second time this season and three Los Angeles Angels pitchers combined for a one-hitter in a 3-0 win over the Texas Rangers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angels' Ryan Johnson, two relievers combine on 1-hitter in 3-0 victory over the Rangers

headlines.description: — Donovan Walton homered and Tommy White had three hits as the Athletics used a big eighth inning to rally for a 4-3 win over the Houston Astros on Saturday night and snap a five-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Athletics rally with a 3-run 8th inning to beat the Astros 4-3, snapping a 5-game skid

events.name: New York Mets at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Luis Robert Jr. hit two home runs against his former team, Bo Bichette, Carson Benge and Luis Torrens also homered and the New York Mets beat the AL Central-leading Chicago White Sox 10-5 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Robert Jr. homers twice against his former team as Mets beat White Sox 10-5

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Eli White slid headfirst into the plate with the winning run to complete a three-run ninth-inning rally, a play that was upheld after a review, and the Boston Red Sox got to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli White slides home headfirst with winning run, play reviewed and Red Sox rally past Giants 3-2

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Kyle Isbel and Salvador Perez hit home runs, Michael Wacha allowed one run and three hits in seven innings, and the Kansas City Royals beat the Detroit Tigers 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royals beat the Tigers 3-1 as Wacha goes 7 innings and Isbel, Perez homer

headlines.description: — Randy Arozarena hit a walk-off, two-run home run as the Seattle Mariners beat the Chicago Cubs 5-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arozarena's walk-off homer gives Mariners 5-4 win over Cubs in Anderson’s MLB debut

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal struck out 11 to earn his first win as a Dodger,
headlines.shortLinkText: Skubal fans 11 for his first Dodgers win as Los Angeles rallies past the Pirates, 4-3

headlines.description: — Jo Adell homered, Tanner Bibee threw six solid innings for his first victory in a month and the Cleveland Guardians held on to beat the Colorado Rockies 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adell homers, Bibee gets 1st win in a month as the Guardians beat the Rockies 4-3

headlines.description: — JJ Bleday hit for the cycle in his first four at-bats, Elly De La Cruz also had four hits and the Cincinnati Reds routed the Arizona Diamondbacks 11-5 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bleday hits for cycle, De La Cruz also has 4 hits as Reds rout Diamondbacks 11-5

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jake Cronenworth raced home with the tying run on an error and Ty France singled in the go-ahead run during a four-run rally in the seventh inning that gave the San Diego Padres a 7-5 win against the Minnesota Twins on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres rally behind Cronenworth, France in 7th inning to beat Twins 7-5
